source.caption: SHAP-based comparison of key feature contributions in the Stacking and CatBoost models. The horizontal axis represents the percentage contribution of each feature. Bubble size indicates the magnitude of feature importance, and color intensity reflects relative contribution strength. PseAAC and AAC-PSSM features are shown, highlighting the dominant role of sequence composition and evolutionary information.
